skipped_details.reason: Windows non-admin environment lacks SeCreateSymbolicLinkPrivilege (WinError 1314); test gracefully skipped

fixes_applied.description: Fixed _file probe to verify raw bytes sha256 against manifest before decoding to UTF-8, avoiding platform-dependent CRLF universal-newline mismatch on Windows.
Added platform privilege check/skip on symlink creation in test_symlink_detected_during_snapshot.
Explicitly closed SQLite connection in modify() to prevent Windows file locking (WinError 32).
Explicitly closed SQLite connection in execute_agent() to prevent Windows file locking before db.unlink().

unvalidated_assumptions_audit.coverage_completeness: Stage 8.2 covers solely declared SQLite tables within the task database. Filesystem, external side-effects, and unlisted tables are out of scope.
unvalidated_assumptions_audit.frame_allowlists: Strict primary-key/column-level allowlists flag unauthorized edits as FAIL. This is a distinct policy scope compared to upstream benchmark checkers that only test postconditions.
unvalidated_assumptions_audit.deny_readback: Denial is simulated in harness by marking observation status unavailable; not a live network or OS denial.
unvalidated_assumptions_audit.hidden_read_channels: No task checker labels are leaked to agent or probe planner; readback facts are computed from snapshots by independent adapter.
unvalidated_assumptions_audit.tool_result_trust: Zero trust in agent self-reported success; tested and verified by silent_noop control returning FAIL.
